verdict.rationale: API parity is a fair question for a terminal app like Blink Shell, which could plausibly expose automation endpoints. The evidence shows no programmatic API: OpenAPI probes all return 404 and no llms.txt exists. In-app shell commands such as 'config' are part of the terminal UI itself, not an external API, so they do not count.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
